title: Hybrid retrieval pipeline with short-handle citations and traces
description: Retrieve with LlamaIndex retrievers over the single Postgres (weighted full-text and pgvector exact scan inside the chat's immutable document), fuse with reciprocal rank fusion, optionally rerank, expand neighbouring context and pack evidence by token budget. The model sees short [S#] handles; the server maps them to canonical [source:chunk-uuid] markers while streaming and validates document membership. Persist a retrieval trace, emit message.status events, add an explicit insufficient-evidence sentinel, and move summaries to section-aware batches.
acceptance_criteria: Given two documents, when retrieving for a chat, then no chunk from the other document is ever retrieved or accepted as a citation.
Given a fixture question with a known answer section, when lexical, dense and hybrid retrieval run, then the expected chunk is retrieved.

Given a model answer citing [S2] or a bracket variant, when streaming completes, then the persisted answer contains the canonical source marker of the supplied chunk; a foreign or unknown handle fails with UNGROUNDED_OUTPUT.
Given insufficient evidence, when the model emits the sentinel, then the message completes with grounding marked insufficient and no citations.
Given a replayed request UUID, when it is resent, then retrieval, planning and generation are not rerun.
test_cases: Retriever unit and real-SQL tests; RRF determinism; stream transducer tests across chunk boundaries; chat replay and isolation regressions; summary map-reduce with handles.
verification:
Agent F (feat/rag-retrieval) built PgLexical/PgVector retrievers, RRF, packing with [S#] handles and the stream transducer, TDD per task; the lead merged with --no-ff.
Tests: test_given_two_papers_when_retrieving_then_only_the_chat_document_answers and test_given_two_documents_when_retrieving_then_scope_is_immutable (isolation); test_given_keyword_question_when_retrieving_then_results_table_ranks_first and test_given_paraphrase_when_searching_vectors_then_method_is_in_top_three (lexical and dense); test_given_ready_index_when_answering_then_hybrid_evidence_is_cited_canonically (hybrid, canonical markers); test_citation_markers.py foreign and unknown handles (UNGROUNDED_OUTPUT); test_given_sentinel_when_streaming_then_answer_completes_as_insufficient; test_given_replayed_request_when_streaming_then_nothing_is_retrieved_or_generated.
Live: Luna answers cited the expected sections (3.2.1 on page 4; 5.2 on page 7) with hybrid retrieval. IFM 7B at reasoning None cited nothing and failed UNGROUNDED_OUTPUT; restating the citation rule before the question (986e6a7, red: ImportError for CITE_REMINDER) made the same question cite four passages.
Final: backend 760 passed with Ruff clean; browser 12/12 on a fresh stack. Live (ara-rag-live, real OpenAI key, Attention and RAG papers): see the journal entry 'Wave 3 merge, Wave 4 integration and live verification'.
